questions.q: What is the approximate time period when the Silk Road was most active for Indian cultural exchange?
questions.a: The Silk Road was most active for Indian cultural exchange from around 200 BCE to 1200 CE. A wrong answer like "only during the Gupta Empire" reveals the student misunderstands the Silk Road’s longevity, thinking it was limited to one Indian dynasty rather than a centuries-long network spanning multiple kingdoms.
